# searchts

> Keyless web reader for AI agents, built because Claude's own fetch kept coming back empty. Fetch a URL or admit you can't. One read path (`unlocker.fetch`). Fail loud on thin pages, challenges, and login walls.

PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/searchts/ · Repo: https://github.com/capad-xyz/searchts

## Install

- **Keep:** `pipx install "searchts[mcp]"`
- **Try / Claude MCP (no PATH):** `claude mcp add searchts -- uvx --from "searchts[mcp]" searchts mcp serve`
- **venv only:** `pip install "searchts[mcp]"` — not the recommended CLI path

Do **not** `pip install searchts` onto Homebrew/PEP 668 Python. Do **not** invent `searchts search-twitter`. `searchts install --env {local,server,auto}` is real and documented below.

## Demo

```
uvx --from "searchts[mcp]" searchts -v read https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ada_Lovelace
```

`example.com` reads as one short paragraph: that is the whole page. Reddit/LinkedIn often **fail loud** — that is success of honesty, not a broken install.

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED COMMANDS (python -m searchts.helpgen --write) -->
## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `searchts read` | Fetch a page as markdown, or fail and say why. |
| `searchts search` | Find URLs to read. A snippet is not the page. |
| `searchts transcribe` | A player page's words: captions, then Whisper. |
| `searchts grab` | Save the files a page uses: images, css, fonts. |
| `searchts get` | One file through the same unlocker. |
| `searchts mcp serve` | Run the MCP server (stdio default; --http for loopback). |
| `searchts mcp install` | Wire the MCP server into the agents on this machine. |
| `searchts skill install` | Write the slash command and the shared SKILL.md bundle. |
| `searchts doctor` | Which channels are installed, configured, working. |
| `searchts install` | One-shot installer; --system-deps to change things. |
| `searchts setup` | Walk through search, GitHub, Reddit, and Groq in one pass. |
| `searchts configure` | List the keys, set one, or copy cookies from a browser. |
| `searchts login` | Site logins: list, keep, kill, signin, purge-scratch, sweep, check. |
| `searchts uninstall` | Remove config, tokens and skill files. |
| `searchts update` | Update to the latest release (`upgrade` is the same command). |
| `searchts check-update` | Is there a newer version? |
| `searchts watch` | Quick health check for a scheduled task. |
| `searchts version` | Version. |
| `searchts help` | The command index, one command, or the machine-readable catalog. |

Every login verb: `searchts login list`, `searchts login keep`, `searchts login kill`, `searchts login signin`, `searchts login purge-scratch`, `searchts login sweep`, `searchts login check`.

MCP tools: `read_url`, `web_search`, `fetch_asset`, `grab_site`, `get_status`, `transcribe`, `login_status`, `login_signin`, `login_check`, `login_kill`. `read_url` has no `next_url`; use the signed `next_cursor`. MCP results and `--json` output carry `update_available` (`search --json`: one JSON line on stderr).

Machine-readable catalog: `searchts help --json` (`searchts.help.v1`). Full flags, defaults and examples: [docs/cli.md](https://github.com/capad-xyz/searchts/blob/main/docs/cli.md).
<!-- END GENERATED COMMANDS -->

## Not this product

No channel router (`if host==reddit`). No default paid proxies. No cookie Twitter as the core. Doctor probes optional CLIs (`gh`, …) — they are not how `read` works.

Full docs: https://github.com/capad-xyz/searchts/blob/main/README.md
